title: Reduce PDF Size Offline
h1: Reduce PDF Size Completely Offline in Your Browser
description: Reduce the size of your PDF documents offline directly in your browser without any server uploads. 100% secure.

sections.title: Shrink PDF Files Offline
sections.content: Compress large PDFs without an internet connection. Our WebAssembly engine runs entirely offline within your browser.

sections.title: How to Reduce PDF Size Offline

steps.title: Compress
steps.description: Choose compression level and click compress.

steps.title: Download
steps.description: Save the smaller PDF file to your computer.

sections.title: Works Without Internet
sections.content: Once the page is loaded, you can disconnect from the internet and the tool will still work perfectly.
sections.subTitle: True Offline

sections.title: Maximum Privacy Guaranteed
sections.content: Since no data is ever transmitted over the network, your sensitive documents are 100% secure.

sections.title: Efficient Engine
sections.content: High compression ratio with fast processing.

faqs.a: We use WebAssembly to run a powerful PDF compression engine directly inside your browser.
No, you can choose lossless compression to maintain high visual quality.

faqs.q: Is there a file size limit?
faqs.a: No, since it runs locally, you can compress files as large as your device's memory allows.
